market: Arizona East Valley (Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Scottsdale, Queen Creek)

criteria.test: Independent owner-operator. Not a DSO, not corporate-managed. One decision-maker.
2-4 dentists under one roof. Solo scores low (call volume), 5+ scores low (drifts toward DSO).
Sedation, implants/All-on-4, Invisalign. A missed call is a $3-5k case, not a $150 cleaning.
Running new-patient promos: $ exam offers, free consults, gift cards, dedicated landing pages, call-tracking numbers.
Documented coverage hole: no Saturday/evening, weekday closures, voicemail after close, one line serving 2+ locations.
Recent trigger: new location, new associate, ownership change, added sedation/implant line, rebrand.

hard_disqualifiers: Requires named PMS integration, BAA/HIPAA certification, or multilingual support as a precondition
